page.layout: One block of running text, one column, with a centred citation and closing words below it. A woodcut ornament sits below the text, and a gathering signature is printed at the foot. Running head at top centre, page number at top right.

main_text.p: sumptis : ut ex testimonio, auctoritate, iurc-iurando ; praeiudiciis, rumoribus, tabulis. Sed hæc (ut superius monui) quæ non in ratiocinatione, sed in sensibus posita sunt, & facti sunt non artis, nihil ad Dialecticam pertinent. Itaque ex Rhetorum disciplina, in qua sola hæc Aristoteles tradidit, eruenda sunt. Fides enim disputando non ex testibus, sed ex argumentis eruitur. non enim tam auctores in disputando, quàm rationis momenta quærenda sunt:

page.notes: The woodcut ornament below the text is not transcribed. The "1" after "nat.Deor." appears as a small raised figure, probably a reference mark, and is copied as printed. "iurc-iurando" is printed with a line-end hyphen; the word is iureiurando. The signature "T j" is at right below the ornament.
